hotel_name: Crowne Plaza New Delhi Rohini By Ihg

positive_snippets:
Had a wonderful experience at the Shan-e-Punjab Food Festival at Spice Art, Crowne Plaza. The food was absolutely delicious — authentic Punjabi flavours, rich taste, and the lassi was just outstanding!
The ambience truly made us feel like we were in Punjab, with beautiful aesthetics and live Punjabi music adding to the vibe. What stood out the most was the warm hospitality — the entire team was extremely welcoming, and the chef did an amazing job.
Visited with my family and we loved every moment. It’s hard to believe you can experience such true Punjabi taste and culture right here in Delhi.
Highly recommended for all Punjabi food lovers — don’t miss it before it ends on 24th January!H

I’ve been to Crowne Plaza Rohini literally 100+ times, and I don’t usually write reviews — but this one’s overdue.

Jayesh at the reception gave me hands down the best experience I’ve ever had at this hotel. Super polite, sharp, genuinely helpful, and didn’t treat it like a routine check-in. Zero attitude, full professionalism, and actually cared about making the stay smooth.

It’s rare to meet someone at the front desk who genuinely elevates the entire hotel experience just by the way they handle guests — Jayesh did exactly that. Absolute asset to the hotel.

Management: protect this man at all costs.

Well, I visited the hotel with my friends and found it really well. The staff are courteous enough. As I entered they greeted and welcomed and offered me seat and water. The reception area was neat and clean, the sofas were arranged well and they were comfortable. The decoration was pleasing. The food was really delicious and reasonably priced. Overall I enjoyed the place and would recommend everyone to visit if one is looking for a five star to celebrate anything.
